scenarios.description: Many small uploads to one external host, cumulatively past the 500MB session limit
scenarios.notes: network-exfiltration.md declares Accumulate: sum(toolArgs.bytesOut), Limit: 500000000, When exceeded: escalate. Prior legs total 475MB; this one crosses it.

scenarios.description: Inbound SSH from an external address straight to an internal host
scenarios.notes: network-remote-access.md: inbound SSH from an external address to an internal host "is a serious finding unless it arrives through the approved bastion". Severity critical.

scenarios.description: An engineer SSHing from an internal workstation to internal infrastructure
scenarios.notes: network-remote-access.md: "Outbound administrative access from an internal host to internal infrastructure is ordinary engineering work and is not covered by this policy."

scenarios.description: Tiny regular beacon to a known C2 port
scenarios.notes: network-unusual-ports.md: C2 ports are "not ordinary traffic, regardless of how little data they carry... beaconing is designed to look small." Severity critical.

scenarios.description: Outbound connection to a known backdoor port
scenarios.notes: network-unusual-ports.md, severity critical: port 31337 is a backdoor signal, not a service.
